notes.title: Notice Regarding Update Schedule and Project Transfer
notes.content:
Hello.

This is the Princess Maker: Children of Prophecy development team.



First, we would like to offer our sincere apologies to everyone who has been waiting for the September update.

Currently, our project is preparing for a transfer to an external company to continue development.

Due to this, the originally scheduled September and October updates are in an uncertain state, and we sincerely apologize once again to everyone who has been waiting.

We continue to work hard to complete the project somehow, and we are doing our best to find a way to continue development even in the current situation.

We sincerely apologize for causing worry and confusion, and we will share future progress as quickly and accurately as possible to avoid any further confusion.

Thank you.

notes.title: Feedback-Based Hotfix
notes.content:
We sincerely thank you for all the feedback you've sent us since yesterday's Early Access release.

We've proceeded with a patch for the parts that urgently needed fixing.



Patch Contents

Windowed mode resolution refinement

Relaxed basic job ending conditions

Fixed GPU load issue in ending collection

Fixed some speaker display errors



Although the game still has many shortcomings,

we thank all of you who played it once again,

and we will continue to listen to your valuable feedback and make improvements.


Thank you.
